summary: The PDF supports 75 analyzed people (71 by subtraction for human-authored shortlist ratings), so criterion 2 holds. No participant-count error was found; exact randomized and arm totals remain unconfirmed, overlap with c861 is unresolved, and external appendices were inaccessible.
